evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes complementary capabilities for games (invite/join, run rounds, browse/view/export/delete), so game creation is supported.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Complementary capability exists for estimators to use the URL to join the game.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes viewing/selecting items and participant estimation behaviors needed to run a round.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Items are created/added via other stories, so listing them is supported.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes item creation and re-estimation support, so selecting an existing item is feasible.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items
evaluations.rationale: Complementary read/update/delete behaviors for items exist, indicating a complete CRUD set for items.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list
evaluations.rationale: Editing presumes item creation, which is covered by starting a round/adding/importing items.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list
evaluations.rationale: Deletion presumes items exist; creation/addition/import is present in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes participants giving estimates and the default behavior of showing after all have estimated; this story complements that flow.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Requires that estimates exist and are visible/collectable; backlog includes estimate submission and reveal behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: estimate field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Depends on estimate submission and reveal; those capabilities are present.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Complements other acceptance mechanisms (average/auto-fill) and presumes estimates exist, which is covered.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation presumes prior rounds/items exist; backlog includes creating rounds/items and selecting items to re-estimate.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Imported stories become items; backlog includes listing/selecting/editing/deleting items, completing the lifecycle.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Same as import: provides creation path for items that are then managed by other item stories.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Games can be created and stored; transcript viewing/exporting provides complementary access to past game content.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Transcript presumes games/rounds/items/estimates exist; backlog includes creating games, running rounds, and capturing estimates.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export complements transcript viewing; transcript creation is supported by gameplay stories.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Export complements transcript viewing; transcript creation is supported by gameplay stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Deletion presumes games exist; game creation is present.

evaluations.evidence: create an account
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes complementary account lifecycle actions (login, change details, delete, password reminder).

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login presumes account creation, which is present; password reminder supports recovery.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account update presumes account creation, which is present.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion presumes account creation; also aligns with game deletion/storage concerns in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: This is a cross-cutting display capability and does not expose a missing complementary CRUD/flow requirement in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder presumes accounts exist and complements login; account creation/login are present.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {…} or {…}
evaluations.rationale: Card-set selection complements the estimation flow; estimation and reveal behaviors exist.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: This refines inviting/joining; complementary join capability exists.

evaluations.evidence: join a game ... received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining presumes invitation/URL exists; backlog includes moderator invitation by URL and game creation.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Items are created/selected by moderator stories, enabling participants to view them.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Items are created/added/imported and can be listed by moderator; participant view complements that.

evaluations.evidence: see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Backlog lacks an explicit story for participants/estimators to submit/play an estimate (select a card). Without estimate entry, showing that an estimate was given is incomplete.

evaluations.evidence: after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Requires the capability for estimators to give/submit an estimate (play a card), but no user story specifies estimate submission. This exposes a missing complementary creation/action capability.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate
evaluations.rationale: Changing an estimate presumes an estimate can be initially submitted, but the backlog has no explicit story for submitting/playing an estimate.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior estimates presumes estimates are captured via an estimate-submission capability, which is not explicitly present in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Requires that participants can submit estimates; backlog does not include a story for playing/submitting an estimate, creating a completeness gap.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Timer start is complemented by a reset behavior story; no missing prerequisite capability is implied beyond being in a game/round.

evaluations.evidence: timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Reset trigger depends on the capability to 'play an estimate' (submit an estimate), which is not explicitly covered by any story, exposing a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes running rounds and transcript viewing, which supports retaining and viewing prior-round information (assuming estimates exist).

evaluations.evidence: cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: This is a UI consistency requirement and does not imply a missing complementary CRUD/flow story.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Changing an estimate presumes initial estimate submission ('play/select a card'), which is not explicitly present in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Displaying a participant photo implies a way to provide/upload/set that photo, but no story covers adding/managing participant photos.

evaluations.evidence: compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Non-functional compliance story does not expose a missing complementary functional capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Standalone documentation capability; no complementary CRUD/flow requirement is implied as missing.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Implementation/quality task; does not imply missing complementary user-facing capability.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Compatibility requirement; does not expose a missing complementary functional story.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility requirement; does not imply a missing complementary functional capability.

evaluations.evidence: respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance requirement; does not reveal a missing complementary functional step.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Internationalization requirement; does not expose a missing complementary functional capability.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Usability/architecture requirement; does not imply a missing complementary functional story.

evaluations.evidence: nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error-handling requirement; does not expose a missing complementary functional capability.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Requires collecting/storing identifiable participant identity (e.g., mapping 'estimator A' to a person) and then de-identifying it, but backlog lacks any explicit capability to manage participant identities beyond entering a name to join; no story covers anonymization/pseudonym assignment or identity management needed to support non-identifiable storage.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics require capturing/aggregating usage events/data, but backlog contains no complementary stories to define what usage data is recorded or how it is collected for metrics.
